authority: Existing authenticated Authority request namespace and Ledger plus CodingDispatch; no peer-controlled settlement or global context injection

trust: Trusted same-host Python services and injected transport, authenticated principal control RPC, trusted-group event provenance; no hostile-code or network-sandbox claim
